data.title: 摩根 · 圣枪誓约
data.description: 【摩根 · 圣枪誓约】冬宫的高台上，摩根单手拄着圣枪伦戈米尼亚德，长裙被晚风拂动，冰蓝瞳仁映着天边的最后一缕光——「圣枪之下，我将以这片土地为誓，守护到底。」
data.action: 站在冬宫高台上，一手稳住竖立的圣枪，另一手垂在裙侧，望向余晖
data.camera: full-body shot, upright lance and palace platform visible
data.promptProse: Morgan steadies upright Rhongomyniad on the palace terrace, its lower end beside her feet, while her free hand relaxes against the layered black-and-blue skirt. Breeze lifts a wing-sleeve edge beneath her crown and icy eyes. The full-body view includes the raised platform and distant battlements. Golden sunset lights her crown and facing folds; the lance's close golden-cyan glow illuminates her gripping hand and a small patch of terrace stone.
